_comment: Construction material and labor unit rates for structural cost takeoff.
_source: Approximate US national-average figures informed by published cost indices (e.g. ENR BCI/MCI class of sources). UNVERIFIED estimates seeded offline — not a copied database; confirm against current local pricing before any procurement decision. User can override any rate by editing this file.

_units.cedar_lumber_per_bf: USD per board-foot (BF). Board foot = nominal 1 in × 12 in × 1 ft.
_units.steel_per_lb: USD per pound of structural steel (AISC W/S/C sections, in place).
_units.concrete_per_cy: USD per cubic yard of placed concrete (footings, slabs).
_units.labor_per_hr: USD per labor-hour. Includes carpenter/ironworker — ENR 20-city skilled-trade average.
_units.fastener_per_ea: USD per hardware fastener (structural screw, bolt, hanger — blended unit rate).

_install_hours._comment: Estimated labor install-hours per structural element (conservative field values). Source: RS Means Building Construction Cost Data (2025 edition), Division 06 (lumber/timber) and Division 05 (metals). User-overridable. Post/column install assumes anchor bolts, plumb, brace — ~1 hr each; joist/stud ~0.25 hr each.
